name: Auto Signal
summary: Place railway signals at a fixed interval, working back from the forward end of the track section.
description:
Enable the mod, open the railway signal tool and leave Auto placement on. Choose the signal model, direction and spacing, then place one signal on the target section. Default spacing is 300 m. The slider covers 50–800 m; click the value to enter any positive whole number of metres, including values above 800.

Placement begins 1 m before the endpoint in the signal's facing direction and works backwards at the chosen interval. The clicked position only triggers placement. The remainder stays at the rear; short sections receive one signal at the front. Same-direction signals are replaced using the selected model, direction and one-way setting. Reverse-facing signals and other track objects are preserved. Turn Auto placement off to place signals manually.

Rail junctions, construction-owned tracks and track ends bound the section; ordinary track seams do not. Road level crossings do not split it: a blocked target moves backwards to an allowed position, and the next interval is measured from that actual signal. Bridges and tunnels are not treated as level crossings. Closed loops without endpoints need manual placement. Requests exceeding 1,000 signals are skipped. A rejected build keeps the original signals. The mod does not infer station entrances, exits or line purpose. Do not enable Automatic Signal Spacing at the same time.

zh_CN.name: 自适应铁路信号灯
zh_CN.summary: 从区段前端开始，按指定间距向后布置信号灯。
zh_CN.description:
启用模组后，打开铁路信号灯工具，保持“自动布置”开启，选好型号、朝向和间距，在目标区段放置一盏灯。默认间距300米，滑块范围50～800米；点击数值可输入其他正整数米，最小1米，也可超过800米。

从信号朝向前方的区段末端之前1米开始，按指定间距向后布灯。点击位置只触发布置，余量留在后端；短区段只放前端一盏，不重新均分或居中。同向旧灯会被替换，新灯沿用本次型号、朝向和单向属性；反向信号灯与其他轨道对象保留。关闭“自动布置”可恢复手动放置。

铁路交点、结构所属轨道和轨道末端为区段边界，普通接缝不分段。公路平交道口不分段；目标灯位落入禁放范围时沿倒排方向顺延到可放位置，再从实际灯位计距。桥隧跨越不按平交道口处理。无端点环线需手动布置；一次超过1000盏时不执行。建造失败保留原灯。模组不识别进站、出站或线路用途。请勿同时启用Automatic Signal Spacing。
